title: Native Windows lab provisioning
summary: The native Windows lab adapter uses Windows OpenSSH and PowerShell, an interactive scheduled task for desktop screenshots and console checks, profile goldens that preserve live identities, and a lease-bound machine-settings recovery journal. Standard-user task control uses native Task Scheduler COM; protected SYSTEM receipts provide current-lease Windows feature evidence. SSH is key-only from any address. Human RDP is allowed over verified Tailscale self addresses or adapters, never the public internet; an SSH forward remains available for bootstrap. A private bounded SYSTEM probe verifies tailnet identity without selecting an administrator's Tailscale profile. Fresh setup requires an approved genuine nickname preference edit and separate deallocated-start coldboot proof of selected profile, startup target and private routes; command success alone does not prove persistence. Provisioning and live restoration require separate machine receipts before readiness is claimed. A macOS controller installs a controllable Windows App before a bounded VM window; local installation authentication and a timed private RDP password prompt are operator handoffs. Administrator staging cleanup failures remain fatal with named recovery and retain completed command diagnostics privately; they do not prove the primary command failed.
